question: Are rainfall-associated new strong choruses (dry CallingIndex 0 -> wet CallingIndex 2-3) mainly reactivation of species already recorded at the same physical site or route in years before the focal pair?
population: Frozen matched NAAMP pairs restricted to pairs with identical nonmissing SiteID at all ten StopNumbers.
history: Primary history uses only eligible runs in the same State x RouteNumber x RunNumber stratum with SurveyYear strictly earlier than the earlier year of the focal pair.
focal_cells: Species x physical SiteID cells with dry CallingIndex=0 and wet CallingIndex in {2,3}.

categories.same_site_prior_strong: Species had CallingIndex 2 or 3 at the same SiteID in at least one prior eligible run.
categories.same_site_prior_weak_only: Species was previously recorded at the same SiteID, but only at CallingIndex 1.
categories.route_only_prior: Species occurred in a prior run of the same route-season stratum, but never at the focal SiteID.
categories.no_prior_stratum_record: Species had no prior record anywhere in the route-season stratum.

exact_decompositions.strong_new_score: Sum wet CallingIndex over focal cells = same-site-prior-strong + same-site-prior-weak-only + route-only-prior + no-prior, each weighted by wet CallingIndex.
exact_decompositions.strong_new_count: Count focal cells partitioned by the same four categories.
exact_decompositions.new_ci3_count: Count dry=0, wet=3 cells partitioned by the same four categories.

models: Fit every pair-level component with the existing matched-pair model: rain_contrast + temperature_difference + day_of_year_difference + year_gap + State + RunNumber, route-clustered covariance.
gate: At least 1500 physically stable pairs and 300 routes with >=1 prior eligible run in the same stratum.
primary_rule: Prior-memory strong activation is supported if the recurrent strong_new_score component (all categories except no_prior) has complete 95% CI >0 and contributes >50% of the total strong_new_score rainfall coefficient.
secondary_rule: Same-site strong-memory concentration is descriptive: report the fraction of the total strong_new_score rainfall coefficient assigned to same_site_prior_strong; no pass threshold.
interpretation: Prior same-site records support acoustic/behavioural reactivation of a previously observed local population more than literal new colonization.
Prior CallingIndex 2-3 at the same site is a stronger 'chorus memory' marker but does not prove continuous local occupancy.
No prior record can reflect rarity or imperfect historical detection as well as genuine arrival.
No causal rainfall, movement, abundance, or reproductive-success claim is authorized.
sensitivity: Repeat the identical prior-history decomposition in the intersection with the existing same-observer pair set; descriptive robustness uses the same >50% recurrent-score rule.
